title: Latent Diffusion with LLMs for Reasoning

contributions.purpose: 解决自回归 LLM 因每 token 计算恒定、须按数据集顺序生成而不适合复杂推理的根本局限
contributions.mechanism: 将潜在扩散模型(LDM)与 encoder-decoder transformer(以 BART 编码表示为 base)结合的混合架构,在潜空间通过多步去噪进行推理,不受 token 顺序约束
contributions.evaluation: 在自建单数字加法(3-5 个数,CoT 链)与模拟空间旋转推理任务上,对比 fine-tuned BART / encoder-decoder;latent diffusion(T=500/1000/4000)在需较多推理的情形下表现更好
contributions.domain: 大语言模型推理 / 扩散模型
contributions.source_quote: We show that combining latent diffusion models with an encoder-decoder transformer architecture provides a scalable way to address some of the fundamental shortcomings posed by autoregressive models.

contributions.purpose: 论证潜空间推理相比按序生成 token 的优势(首个此方向探索)
contributions.mechanism: 实验分析:比较 latent diffusion 与自回归/随机基线在 token 难度不均、可复用层做重复算术等场景的表现
contributions.evaluation: 空间推理任务中 encoder-decoder 表现仅与随机基线相当且末期预测 EOT;latent diffusion 无需依赖数据集顺序即可由简单链外推更难答案(定性 + Table 结果)
contributions.domain: 大语言模型推理 / 扩散模型
contributions.source_quote: To our knowledge, this is the first work exploring the augmentation of latent diffusion for reasoning.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Previous related work shows that discrete diffusion models have reasoning potential but lack the training efficiency to rival traditional LLMs (Gulrajani & Hashimoto, 2024). By combining encoder-decoder transformer with diffusion, we can leverage the best of both worlds

we use BART (Lewis et al., 2019) extensively throughout our experiments to obtain its encoder representations. In constrast to next sequence prediction, the decoder is fine-tuned to generate the original sequence given the encoder representation.

It has also been shown that latent diffusion text models outperform discrete diffusion text models, strengthening our claim that operating in latent space yields improvements over operating with discrete tokens (He et al., 2022; Lovelace et al., 2024b).

notes: 明确 caveat/负结果:(1)作者自承与 GPT-3 的算术对比『might not be a fair comparison』因 GPT-3 未针对算术 fine-tune;(2)承认扩散训练相对传统 LM 低效,推测因 token 同时扩散带来组合爆炸、梯度噪声大——列为 notable limitation。定性主张为主,缺乏大规模基准与精确指标值;属探索性可行性论文(decision: reject)。
